# ScrollBar

ScrollBar — a wrapper that applies the Design System's tokenized custom scrollbar styling (thin width, border-colored thumb, transparent track) to its scrollable content.

**Import:** `import { ScrollBar } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/ScrollBar/ScrollBar.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/ScrollBar/ScrollBar.stories.jsx` — Overview, Layout, Content, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/ScrollBar/ScrollBar.mdx`

## Usage

Use `ScrollBar` when a region has to scroll inside a page that does not — a long
list in a fixed panel, a wide table in a narrow column. It caps the height,
turns on overflow, and applies the design system's thin scrollbar so the region
does not draw the platform's default one.

`maxHeight` (default twice `--size-1000`) caps a vertical region. `horizontal`
switches the axis, and in that mode `maxHeight` is ignored — the width comes
from the container.

## Alternatives

- For a long list that should page rather than scroll, use `Pagination`.
- For content the user opens rather than scrolls past, use `Accordion`.

## Best practices

### Use one scrollbar per region. {#use-one-scrollbar-per-region}

Two bars side by side suggest two scrolling areas where there is one. Do not nest one region inside another on the same axis.

Do: A single scrollbar.
Don't: A region nested in another: two scrollbars on one region.

### Keep the track thin. {#keep-the-track-thin}

The scrollbar stays at its natural width; stretching it competes with the content. It has no width prop, so leave its styling as shipped.

### Wrap only content that overflows. {#wrap-only-content-that-overflows}

A region around content that already fits shows no bar and still adds a tab stop with nothing to scroll.

Do: A region around a list that overflows.
Don't: A region around two short items.

### Use `maxHeight` to cap height, not to fill a taller container. {#use-maxheight-to-cap-height-not-to-fill-a-taller-container}

`maxHeight` is a cap. In a taller container, give the region the height you want it to take, such as `maxHeight="100%"`.

Do: The region fills its container and scrolls.
Don't: A smaller cap leaves the space below it empty.

### Name each region. {#name-each-region}

```jsx
// Incorrect — two scroll regions on a page, both announced as the default "Scrollable content".
<ScrollBar><SessionList /></ScrollBar>
<ScrollBar><NoteList /></ScrollBar>

// Correct.
<ScrollBar aria-label="Sessions"><SessionList /></ScrollBar>
<ScrollBar aria-label="Notes"><NoteList /></ScrollBar>
```

### Scroll on one axis, not both. {#scroll-on-one-axis-not-both}

`horizontal` chooses which axis is styled and which cap applies. A table that
needs horizontal scroll inside a page that scrolls vertically uses one axis on
each container.

## Accessibility

- **The region is focusable on purpose.** `tabIndex={0}` lets a keyboard user
  scroll it with the arrow keys and satisfies the scrollable-region-focusable
  rule.
- **Give multiple regions distinct names.** `aria-label` defaults to
  "Scrollable content". When a page has more than one scroll region, name each
  for what it holds.
- **Not a landmark.** It omits `role="region"` so multiple scroll areas on a
  page do not collide as landmarks; `aria-label` names the tab stop directly.
- **Do not hide the last row.** A scroll region whose content ends exactly at the
  cap looks finished. Leave the cut visible so the reader knows more content sits
  below.

## Related

- `StaticTable`: use when wrapping a wide data table in a horizontal `ScrollBar` rather than shrinking its columns.
- `Panel`: use when scrolling body content inside `PanelBody`.

Same group: `Accordion` · `Carousel` · `PageHeader`

## Parts

1. **Region.** The wrapper that caps the height and scrolls.
2. **Track.** Transparent, so it never reads as a second edge.
3. **Thumb.** The border-colored bar, darker under the pointer.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | A thin thumb in the border color on a transparent track. |
| Hovered | The thumb takes the bold border color. |
| Pressed | No pressed layer. |
| Focused | The region takes focus from Tab, named by `aria-label`. |
| Disabled | A scroll region has no disabled state. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Thumb | `--ds-border`; `--ds-border-bold` on hover. |
| Track and corner | Transparent. |
| Width | `--space-0375`. |
| Corner | `--radius-md`. |
| Height cap | twice `--size-1000` by default. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the region for what is in it: "Session notes". | Leave the region unnamed. |
| Give a horizontal region a width its content cannot fit. | Wrap content that already fits. |
| Keep the label short and specific. | Start it with "Scrollable". |

| `children` | node | — | — |
| `maxHeight` | string or number | `'var(--scroll-bar-max-height)'` | Maximum height before vertical scrolling begins (e.g., "240px") |
| `horizontal` | bool | `false` | Scroll horizontally instead of vertically |
